settings.topology: Eight logical embedded rank clients feed one shared drive. Per-client segment, staging and quota use the project budgets in kimi-k3-b300-step2/resolved.json.
settings.natural_restore: Use native prefix lookup, leases and BatchEvict. Prefer a memory replica on GET. A disk replica becomes readable on successful bucket publication.

topology.basis: Embedded rank-local segments are a supported deployment. Eight clients, one SSD and the space assigned to them describe the chosen deployment.

ssd.basis: One Micron 7450 PRO E1.S 3.84 TB as a same-form-factor surrogate for one DGX drive. Table 1, E1.S 15/25 mm, 128 KB sequential, steady state, QD32, power state 0. Separate decimal MB/s directions share one virtual FIFO. Small and mixed I/O require measurement.
